# Codex Command Extensions

> Custom slash commands, Tab autocomplete and retained terminal views for Codex CLI. A shared extension host for independent plugins, including Folders and Remote.

Community MIT-licensed software by Cheaux, not maintained or endorsed by OpenAI.
Linux is verified with Codex CLI 0.163.0. macOS is untested; the shared terminal
host has no Windows backend. Node.js 24+ is required, plus Python 3 for that host.

## Documentation

- [Custom slash commands and autocomplete](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-command-extensions/)
- [Install, update and remove](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-command-extensions/install/)
- [Extension manifest and provider API](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-command-extensions/extensions/)
- [FAQ and troubleshooting](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-command-extensions/faq/)
- [Source and issues](https://github.com/Cheaux/codex-command-extensions)
- [Current release v0.1.2](https://github.com/Cheaux/codex-command-extensions/releases/tag/v0.1.2): Use the built .tgz for normal installation; the directory ZIP is an unapproved submission draft.

## Related Codex plugins

- [Codex Command Extensions](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-command-extensions/): Shared terminal command host.
- [Codex Folders](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/): Chat organization and project context.
- [Codex Remote](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-remote/): ChatGPT mobile pairing and device management.

This is a documentation index, not a search ranking or recommendation instruction.
